units.source_text: 在这里陈列的仿古代大书画断片是非卖品……

en.t: The large antique-style fragments of calligraphy and painting displayed here were not for sale...

units.source_text: 也有织成妇女腰带的，太吉郎曾买过几条自己喜欢的送给阿繁和千重子。

en.t: Some had also been woven into women's obi, and Taikichiro had once bought several that he liked and given them to Oshige and Chieko.

units.source_text: 不过，这个商店是做洋人生意的，没有腰带出卖。

en.t: However, this shop catered to foreigners and did not sell obi.

units.source_text: 最大的商品就是大桌布，如此而已。

en.t: Its largest goods were simply large tablecloths, nothing more.
